reference.qualification: Fixed profile slopes and breaks; independent Gaussian shape errors as in the cited method. The diagnostic compares the stellar distribution, not the simulated stock inertia axes to a dark-halo density parameter. It is conditional on the parametric stellar target and does not reproduce a full data likelihood.

qualification: Supplementary 6-60 kpc stellar shape diagnostic. The main retention results remain the registered 10-40 kpc cut. No observational success probability is assigned; finite-tracer noise, shape-systematic uncertainties, noncoplanarity and the full selection function are not modeled.
